compute_mse_loss: compute the mean squared error between two PyTorch image tensors with optional valid mask
calculate_psnr: calculate the peak signal-to-noise ratio between two images using scikit-image
calculate_ssim: calculate the structural similarity index between two multichannel images using scikit-image
